sentences.en: Australia’s hospitality workforce has traditionally relied on international students.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚的服务业主要依赖国际学生作为员工。

sentences.en: Much of the workforce is employed in banana production and tourism.
sentences.zh: 大部分劳动力都从事香蕉生产和旅游业。

sentences.en: It is preferable for Algeria's economy to have a young workforce.
sentences.zh: 对于阿尔及利亚的经济来说，拥有年轻的劳动人口更为理想。

senses.zh: 全体员工 - (国家或行业等)劳动力,劳动大军,劳动人口
